items.raw_excerpt: The Cook Islands has been named as Oceania's Leading Island Destination for a fourth consecutive year at the 2026 World Travel Awards (WTA).

items.raw_excerpt: Seán Canney TD, Minister of State for International and Road Transport, Logistics, Rail and Ports and Leader in Cabinet of the Independent Ministers, is encouraging community groups across Galway to submit Expressions of Interest for the 2026 Town and Village Renewal Scheme by 23 October 2026. The scheme supports small to medium-sized, shovel-ready capital
items.summary_en: Ireland's transport minister Sean Canney asks community groups in Galway to apply for the 2026 Town and Village Renewal Scheme. The fund pays for small capital projects that towns and villages can start quickly. Applications close on 23 October 2026.

items.raw_excerpt: A performance of “The Star-Spangled Banner” by Mariachi Herencia de México on “Monday Night Football” this week drew cheers and made history.
items.summary_en: The mariachi group Herencia de Mexico played "The Star-Spangled Banner" on Monday Night Football. The crowd cheered, and it was the first time an all-mariachi group played the US national anthem on the show. People in the United States and Mexico shared the moment online.

items.title_original: The Herencia de México mariachi group makes history on Monday Night Football

items.raw_excerpt: O tsunami meteorológico que atingiu o litoral sul de Santa Catarina em 21 de setembro expôs limitações da rede de monitoramento do país. Pesquisadores afirmam que a falta de séries históricas e a baixa quantidade de sensores dificultam determinar a frequência desses fenômenos.
items.summary_en: A meteorological tsunami hit the southern coast of Santa Catarina on September 21. Researchers say the country has too few sensors and too little past data to know how often these events happen.
items.summary_ko: 9월 21일 산타카타리나 남부 해안을 기상 쓰나미가 덮쳤다. 연구자들은 센서가 적고 과거 자료도 부족해 이런 현상이 얼마나 자주 일어나는지 파악하기 어렵다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Lack of Data Limits Tracking of Meteorological Tsunamis
items.title_ko: 기상 쓰나미 관측망의 빈틈 드러내
items.title_original: Falta de dados limita monitoramento de tsunamis meteorológicos

items.raw_excerpt: Daniel Tupou is edging closer to becoming the first Roosters player in more than 80 years to win four premierships because he always finds his best on the biggest day of the season.
items.summary_en: Daniel Tupou is close to winning his fourth premiership with the Sydney Roosters. He plays his best football on the biggest day of the year. If he wins, he will be the first Roosters player in more than 80 years to lift four titles.
items.summary_ko: 댄얼 투푸가 시드니 로스터스에서 네 번째 우승을 거둘 가능성이 커졌다. 그는 그랜드 파이널처럼 중요한 경기일수록 좋은 경기를 낸다. 우승하면 80년 만에 네 번 우승한 로스터스 선수가 된다.
items.title_en: Why Daniel Tupou is a Sydney Roosters grand final specialist

items.raw_excerpt: In her 20s, the writer thought keeping your age private was silly. Now, she understands why some women choose to do so: Revealing your age can give people a reason to judge your work, appearance and relevance before they know you.
items.summary_en: A writer in her twenties once thought hiding your age was silly. Later, her own age was used against her at work. Now she understands why some women keep their age private.

items.raw_excerpt: Australia gives captain Sophie Molineux every chance to play in white-ball matches against Bangladesh and New Zealand, as she battles a hip injury.
items.summary_en: Australia cricket captain Sophie Molineux has a real chance to play white-ball matches against Bangladesh and New Zealand. She is still recovering from a hip injury. Her team hopes she will be ready for the home series.

items.raw_excerpt: The Australian Education Union (AEU) says half a million dollars will not be enough to cover all necessary infrastructure upgrades at the new Alice Springs high school merger.
items.summary_en: The Australian Education Union says $500,000 will not pay for all the building work the merged Alice Springs College needs. The union and local residents call the money far too small. The new school joins several older schools into one campus in Alice Springs.

items.raw_excerpt: As the transition period for the Beverage Container Return Scheme draws to a close, how has the scheme changed consumer behaviour, and will this translate into better recycling habits in the long run?
items.summary_en: The first transition period of Singapore's beverage container return scheme is ending. People who once collected containers now bring them back only when it is convenient. It is still unclear whether the new habit will last.

items.summary_en: The Chettinad Heritage and Cultural Festival is back in Tamil Nadu, India. Local people are restoring old mansions, old crafts, and old food traditions. They turn this heritage into tourism, learning, and lasting change for the area.
